sources.title: CAS Shield
sources.notes: beds.cas-shield.com resolves (HTTP 200) and serves Enroly's CAS Shield login page (page text contains 'Enroly' and 'CAS Shield'), so University of Bedfordshire uses Enroly CAS Shield for its CAS process. Enroly pre-CAS interviews draw randomised questions from themed banks; no question list is published on the site.

sources.title: Doing well in an interview | University of Bedfordshire
quotes: The people interviewing you are assessing your suitability for the course and university; your interest in the subject; your commitment and readiness to study; and your ability to communicate clearly.
sources.notes: From search snippet only. General admissions-interview advice page, not specifically a credibility/pre-CAS interview page; no questions.
